button.title: Screen Solver (Screenshare to solve i-Ready & tests)

input.placeholder: Ask younis or enter any website

iframe.allow: fullscreen; autoplay; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; gamepad

div.div: Hello! I am your unlimited younis AI assistant. I can analyze images, search the web, and solve tests or questions. Ask me anything or paste an image!

input.placeholder: Type a message or paste image...

button.title: Float over ChatGPT / i-Ready (Always on Top)

input.placeholder: Ask about what's on your screen...

div.div: Select ChatGPT, i-Ready, or any test tab to begin solving
